launch_question: Did you close or stop the earlier launch?
launch_detail: The earlier terminal or application may still be starting the provider. Close or stop that launch before allowing another resume request.
take_over_detail: Agent Relay will stop the background process running this session, check that it exited, then resume the session here.
helper_missing: This copy of Agent Relay is missing its session helper, so it cannot open sessions. Reinstall Agent Relay.
rejected: The session helper could not read this request. Update Agent Relay.
plan_failed: Couldn’t check this session’s location. Try again.
open_unknown: Agent Relay did not get an answer, so it is unknown whether the session opened. Check before trying again.
open_not_started: Agent Relay could not start opening this session. No new session was started.
already_opening: This session is already being opened.
